text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Sweep Tosho at the academy. It looks like she's practicing board breaking for "Karate," but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gama-gama, chinkuchi!
Nafadii, suidii!
My body, become as swift as the wind!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, it won't break at all!! With a huge pop-pop-pop!! Why won't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's enough of number one!
Karate Power-Up Spell Number Two!
Naifanchi, Naifanchi, Suparinpei!

Heh heh heh... How naive!
Sweep-san of the Magic-Style Karate!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Using a spell to boost physical ability
and smashing boards in a super-fast flash...
Not a bad idea, but you're not there yet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"What?! Are you saying you've got
an even better trick up your sleeve, Fukukitaru?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Of course there is!
And that is... our Seiun-style Karate!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By using a breathing technique that inhales good fortune, my luck increases!
A lucky punch strikes the wooden board's vital point, snapping it as easily as a shrimp cracker!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that about?!
Even I could apply clairvoyance to—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yah! Tou! Ei! Tah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*bonk, bonk*)

Oh, hungry young wolves――
――but it seems your training is still lacking.
Got it? Just you watch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATATATAT!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! All the targets in a split second...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pearl!?
Don't tell me you've got your own style of karate too...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Using a chant as a battle cry, making heaven your ally.
Hmm, a fine Special.
...HOW-EV-ER! My conclusion is different!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Relentlessly fierce! Blazing fast!
A passionate dance flailing limbs all about! And then...
Before you know it, all surrounding targets are DESTROYED!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "This is—the karate of someone who has seen the world. The King of Karate style—Dancing Karate!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't that
just throwing a tantrum while dancing!?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, the Seiun Style still has plenty of tricks up its sleeve!
For instance, the long-range technique of shooting evil-banishing arrows in all directions to strike distant targets—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair! If that's allowed,
then I can use magic cane arts to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Three schools clashing fiercely against one another... It's impossible to predict how it will end, but if things continue like this heading into the actual race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It feels like we're all gonna be made to sit in seiza and get lectured by some big shot about 'What Karate Truly Is.'
